name: When should I consider a room addition instead of moving to a new home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a room addition instead of moving to a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider a room addition when you love your current neighborhood, have a good school district, or want to stay close to work and family, but simply need more space. It's often a more cost-effective solution than incurring moving expenses, real estate fees, and higher property taxes on a new, larger home. An addition allows you to customize the new space exactly to your needs while increasing your property value and enhancing your existing lifestyle without changing your address.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for a room addition when you value your current location but need more space. It can be more cost-effective than moving, allows customization, and increases your home's value.
